question_1: Is signed-mandate enforcement required for this campaign?

finding.why: MANDATE_PUBKEYS = {} is the SHIPPED STATE, documented in l5_mandate_signature as 'EMPTY IS THE SHIPPED STATE and it means no mandate can verify, which is the correct default: an empty registry refuses everything rather than trusting anything.' The gate is self-activating: it binds exactly when the registry is non-empty. The owner has never generated the pair, so MANDATE_NO_TRUSTED_KEY is the designed initial condition, not a lost configuration.
finding.self_activating_consequence: once the public half is committed in a reviewed change, a signature becomes REQUIRED for live arming and no variable edit can satisfy it -- so turning the gate OFF afterwards takes a repo commit and a deploy, not an environment change.

answer: REQUIRED, under the owner's own criterion. The alternative mechanism meets HALF of it.

independent_and_durable_ALREADY.what: the DOLLARS -- exposure, loss, window count, campaign duration, series
independent_and_durable_ALREADY.how: every ceiling is a CODE CONSTANT and the effective scope is the INTERSECTION of what a document asked for and what the code permits
independent_and_durable_ALREADY.quote: there is deliberately no path by which a number in the document raises a limit, because then the document, not the code, would be the risk control
independent_and_durable_ALREADY.also: an unreadable L5_MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE_USD returns None, which surfaces as three independent refusals (CAMPAIGN_RUNNING_LIMITS_UNREADABLE, ACCOUNT_EXPOSURE_CEILING_UNKNOWN, MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE_CEILING_UNREADABLE), so a typo cannot quadruple the envelope

NOT_independent.what: the AUTHORIZATION DECISION, its scope and its expiry
NOT_independent.how: the approval document is served by EnvApprovalStore out of the L5_CAMPAIGN_APPROVAL environment variable; the expiry and window count come from L5_LIVE_AUTH_NOT_AFTER and L5_LIVE_AUTH_MAX_WINDOWS. All three are Railway variables, all three confirmed present on the service, and this agent holds a Railway token that can set any of them.
NOT_independent.demonstrated_not_asserted: tests/test_l5_authorization_independence.py::test_THE_GAP_a_document_this_process_composes_is_approved -- a document composed in-process and placed in the variable the gate reads is APPROVED, scope and all. Nothing in the approval path can tell the difference, because the variable IS the credential.
NOT_independent.the_guard_that_does_not_close_it: EnvApprovalStore.put raises 'the executor may not write its own approval'. That stops THIS code path; it does not stop the variable being set by whatever set the others.
NOT_independent.the_module_says_so_itself: l5_campaign_approval says Claude cannot write its document; l5_mandate_signature records that this is false in practice, because anyone holding a Railway token can set the variable.

so: If the property wanted is that the DOLLARS are bounded whatever happens, it already holds and the mandate is not needed for it. If the property wanted is that THIS EXECUTOR CANNOT AUTHORIZE ITS OWN CAMPAIGN, only the signed mandate delivers it, because its private half is held offline and this process has never seen it and cannot produce it.

what_I_did_NOT_do_and_will_not.generate_a_keypair: REFUSED. l5_mandate_signature: 'THE PRIVATE KEY NEVER EXISTS HERE. Not in this repository, not in Railway, not in any environment the executor can read, and it is never generated by an agent.' A key this agent generates is a key it has SEEN, so the signature would prove nothing about owner intent -- it would convert a real control into theatre while appearing to satisfy the request. That is weakening a control.
what_I_did_NOT_do_and_will_not.write_a_campaign_approval: not done, and the capability to do it is the finding above, not a workaround.

owner_actions_required_to_enable_it: generate the Ed25519 pair OFFLINE per docs/OWNER_MANDATE_SIGNING.md -- never in this session, never in Railway
commit the PUBLIC half into MANDATE_PUBKEYS as {key_id: 64 hex chars} in a reviewed change (a key_id is never reused: seq monotonicity is tracked per key_id)
sign a mandate payload and set it as L5_MANDATE_DOC (currently ABSENT -- arming would refuse MANDATE_ABSENT until it is set)

prerequisites_already_satisfied.L5_HALT_URL: PRESENT -- required, else a signed mandate is refused MANDATE_REVOCATION_UNAVAILABLE because it would have no immediate withdrawal path
prerequisites_already_satisfied.L5_MANDATE_STORE_URL: PRESENT, and L5_MANDATE_STORE_PROBE reported BOTH_DOCUMENTS_FRESH -- the watchdog publishes the replay floor and the revocation list, read from the watchdog and not our own disk on purpose, because a floor this process can write is a floor it can roll back
prerequisites_already_satisfied.L5_MANDATE_DOC: ABSENT -- the only missing piece, and it is the owner's to supply
prerequisites_already_satisfied.verdict: registering a key would NOT refuse on infrastructure grounds; it would refuse on MANDATE_ABSENT until the owner signs one

the_two_that_answer_the_question.test_a_registered_key_makes_a_signature_: with a key registered and no document, arming refuses MANDATE_ABSENT
the_two_that_answer_the_question.test_writing_the_variable_without_the_ke: its own docstring: 'THE WHOLE POINT. An agent or attacker holding a Railway token can set this variable to anything. None of it verifies.' -- invalid signature, no signature, the campaign shape, 'true', '{}' and 'not json at all' all refuse

enforcement_proven_not_assumed.also_pinned_by_me: with a test-only keypair generated inside the test process and never registered in the shipped module, the campaign-shaped bytes that satisfy the approval path do not verify as a mandate
enforcement_proven_not_assumed.taker_crossing_is_not_expressible: no action name for it and execution_mode must equal MAKER_ONLY, so no signed mandate can authorize a crossing order
enforcement_proven_not_assumed.promotion_is_a_block_never_a_switch: requires_bounded_live_validation must be true; a mandate setting it false is REFUSED

question_2: Verify the safe blocked-arm switching procedure, including confirmed settlement and retirement before restarting into at-touch mode.

procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.why_a_predicate: L5_TS_COMPLETION_AT_TOUCH is read once via os.getenv at l5_live_execution.py:7303 and nothing mutates it in process, so the arms cannot be interleaved per window -- the comparison needs a RESTART between them. The restart is the risk: anything live or unresolved when the process goes down crosses a configuration boundary and is managed on the far side by a DIFFERENT completion policy than the one that created it. A prose checklist is not evidence that nothing crossed.
procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.emitted_on: the HEARTBEAT cadence, NOT at boot -- the question must be answered BEFORE the process goes down; a boot emission would describe the far side of the restart, after anything that was going to cross already had

blockers.HALT_STATE_UNESTABLISHED: halt_latch is None, NO_GATE or unrecognised -- three states, not two, and an unestablished latch is a blocker never a pass
blockers.LIVE_ORDERS_NOT_EMPTY: an order that can still fill
blockers.PENDING_TERMINAL_NOT_EMPTY: an order that left the open list and still owes a fill
blockers.QUARANTINE_NOT_EMPTY: an order whose fate was set aside
blockers.ORDERS_UNCERTAIN: the one case where we cannot even enumerate what would cross
blockers.EXPOSURE_OUTSTANDING: markets_with_exposure() non-empty -- unions committed, positions, leg_cost, live_orders and pending_terminal, minus retired_markets, so it subsumes residual inventory and adopted venue positions
blockers.EXPOSURE_UNREADABLE: an unreadable venue/book read blocks rather than passes
blockers.WINDOW_NOT_RETIRED: a declared window is not in retired_markets
blockers.WINDOW_RETIRED_WITHOUT_SETTLEMENT_RECORD: retired with no settlement figure is a retirement we cannot show was a settlement
blockers.PROBE_FAILED: a probe that cannot answer is never reported as ok

procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.why_the_window_check_is_SEPARATE_from_ex: an empty exposure list is also exactly what a window that NEVER TRADED looks like, so confirmed settlement is required BY NAME and never inferred from a quiet book -- which is the owner's explicit requirement
procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.what_retirement_guarantees: retired_markets is written by exactly ONE function, retire_settled_market, which refuses on ALREADY_RETIRED, LIVE_ORDERS_IN_MARKET, UNBOOKED_TERMINAL_ORDERS, an incoherent book, a settlement price that is not exactly 0 or exactly 1 (a mark is not cash -- Stage A booked a phantom $0.029 credit from a 0.01 mark before this guard), and a resolution that is absent, from another market, or disagreeing with the value booked. It persists, so a restart cannot resurrect it.
procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.latch_not_read_here: halt_asserted is passed IN rather than read, so this module cannot acquire a second divergent reading of a latch HaltGate owns over an owner-controlled object
procedure_is_now_a_PREDICATE_not_a_check.a_zero_is_not_an_absence: a DOWN window settles at yes_value 0 and a flat pair at 0.00 P&L; both count as recorded, where a truthiness test would have read them as missing

the_procedure: 1. arm A (control, L5_TS_COMPLETION_AT_TOUCH unset/false) works its two windows
2. after the second window's settlement, set L5_ARM_SWITCH_WINDOWS to both window slugs and L5_ARM_SWITCH_PROBE=YES
3. assert HALT via L5_HALT_URL and wait for halt_latch to read HALT
4. read L5_ARM_SWITCH_READINESS on the heartbeat until ok is true -- every blocker is named, and blockers accumulate rather than short-circuit so one read shows everything outstanding
5. ONLY THEN set L5_TS_COMPLETION_AT_TOUCH=1 and restart
6. confirm on the new boot that ts_completion_at_touch reads true and the strategy_config_digest moved
7. clear HALT and let arm B work its two windows
8. one window is SKIPPED between the arms so step 2's settlement and retirement can complete; the skipped window is never claimed, so max_windows 4 stays exact
image_closure: src/l5_arm_switch_gate.py added to the Dockerfile COPY list. Its import is guarded, so a missing COPY would NOT fail the boot -- it would report PROBE_FAILED:ModuleNotFoundError at the exact moment an operator is deciding whether a restart is safe. 14 closure tests pass.

economic_conclusion_preserved.this_pilot_is: a completion-EXECUTABILITY probe. It answers one yes/no: does an at-touch maker complement actually fill inside the 120s completion runway, where the two-tick complement provably could not (1445z: own 0.6000 posted into a 0.6200 bid, behind the entire visible queue, unfillable by construction).
economic_conclusion_preserved.this_pilot_is_NOT: proof of positive expectancy. Four windows at a 1-contract clip is at most four completed pairs and has essentially no power to separate the two policies on P&L.
after_execution_is_verified_the_priority: 1. FIRST-LEG ADVERSE SELECTION. The established loss driver, 4 of 4 prior windows, complement monotonically dearer (0.78->0.99, 0.60->0.92, 0.55->0.96, 0.77->0.94). Liquidity was refuted as the cause (446x cover) and the execution defect was refuted as the DRIVER. At-touch completion does not address it.
2. REPEATED COMPLETED-PAIR PROFITABILITY, measured on settlement-only realized P&L with fees, and rebates counted only once credited.
3. NOT extending this pilot indefinitely. More 1-contract windows buy executability evidence we will already have, not expectancy evidence.
economic_conclusion_preserved.the_480_per_day_target: not approachable from this pilot and should not be read as tested by it
